# Apple Flora

[![Apple Flora — Hasbro Studios, Apple Family Reunion (2012)](https://static2.wikia.nocookie.net/__cb20121231043460/mlp/images/f/f5/Apple_Flora_ID_S3E8.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/523118)

Apple Flora is the little yellow Earth pony from the extended Apple family who shares a playful greeting with Candy Caramel Tooth. Look for her swept, two-tone blue mane and tail, warm orange-red eyes, and cutie mark of a red apple surrounded by three pink blossoms. The mark is inconsistently drawn in her debut.

- Name and continuity: An actual G4 Friendship is Magic television character, unnamed on-screen. Apple Flora is an official merchandise name: Hasbro paired her with Candy Caramel Tooth in a 2015 Sweet Apple Acres Story Pack. See the [May 2015 packaging reveal](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2015/05/packaging-and-stock-images-of-all.html). No separate alias or alter ego verified.
- Appearances and voice: A background filly in Apple Family Reunion (S3E8, 2012) and Twilight Time (S4E15, 2014). No individual speaking lines or voice credit verified. See the [character reference and scene descriptions](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Apple_Flora_and_Candy_Caramel_Tooth). No film or comic appearance verified.

[![Fan vector — thatguy1945, 2013](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/10/17/277669/medium.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/277669)

## Important moments

Her limited screen time offers memorable interactions rather than a major character arc.

- Playful reunion — Apple Family Reunion (S3E8): She and Candy Caramel Tooth greet each other with playful hoof-slaps and a noogie, showing the affection that makes the reunion meaningful.
- Racing together — Apple Family Reunion (S3E8): The two fillies team up for the seven-legged race and navigate the obstacle course, reinforcing their bond. [Official full episode for both scenes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7LwXctUyB0I); exact timestamps unavailable.
- Schoolyard reunion — Twilight Time (S4E15): They run alongside one another at the Ponyville schoolyard, a small but recognizable continuation of their friendship. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200164710/s04-e15-twilight-time); timestamp unavailable.
